basics.name: Dhia Ben Hamouda
basics.label: AI Engineer · Machine Learning · LLM Systems · Automation
basics.summary: Computer science engineer who builds AI systems from the model to the API and the interface: document automation, LLM evaluation and decision support. Research experience in machine learning for battery state estimation and EEG decoding.

work.name: Technische Universität Chemnitz, Measurement and Sensor Technology
highlights: Built a framework comparing five electrochemical impedance spectroscopy representations for lithium-ion battery state-of-charge estimation.
Evaluated conventional ML and CNN models leave-one-cell-out, on battery cells unseen in training.
Applied SHAP and Grad-CAM to identify influential features and spectral regions and interpret their physical meaning.

work.name: Proxym Group
highlights: Built an LLM-as-a-Judge SQL evaluation prototype with a Performer-Judge workflow; evaluated 162 internal queries, with a reported 12% reduction in query runtime.
Prototyped human-reviewed credit decision support combining rule-guided ML and LLM reasoning with a FastAPI service and a React interface.

work.name: OZEOL
highlights: Reduced average document-processing time by about 50% by combining OCR, language detection and NLP classification for multilingual files.
Delivered document extraction and normalisation through a Flask API and a React interface, with reported extraction precision above 85% across PDF, Word, Excel and image inputs.
